$comment: D-LINK-MACHO-IMAGE-STATIC-FN-EMITTED-N-EXT: a Mach-O image carrying a `static` function beside an exported one. Both image nlist builders used to stamp N_SECT|N_EXT on every defined function (a `static` reached the image under its real name with the EXTERNAL bit set, LC_DYSYMTAB nlocalsym 0); ld64 emits it N_SECT with no N_EXT, first in the table, under ilocalsym 0 / nlocalsym 1 / iextdefsym 1 (measured 2026-09-04, Apple clang 21.0.0 / ld-1267). The structural pin is tests/link/test_macho_image_symtab_bands.cpp; this example is the RUN witness that an image with a local band loads, passes its ad-hoc signature and exits 42 on darwin, and BUILDS everywhere. Two statics are reached through a const fn-ptr table indexed by a RUNTIME value (argc - 1), a shape chosen so no pass sees a constant index and the statics stay address-taken through the release arm -- that is the INTENT of the shape, not a measurement; what this example asserts is the exit code on both arms: table[0](40) = static_helper(40) = 42. The nlist itself is pinned by tests/link/test_macho_image_symtab_bands.cpp, which compiles the default pipeline. The pe arm RUNS on windows, elf x86_64 on linux, elf arm64 under qemu, macho arm64 on darwin.
